findings.question: Does he choose to shoot more than his role asks?
findings.unit: self-chosen early self-created plays above his team's rate, per 100 team plays
findings.pool: players in the file with a percentile (3,000+ minutes, 2019-20..2025-26 pooled)
findings.caveat: Stable year to year (r 0.89), but stability can reflect a stable role rather than a choice.

findings.question: How good is he at creating his own shot?
findings.unit: creation-skill score (pull-up, drive, iso, pick-and-roll), league SD units
findings.caveat: Tracks Hawk-Eye shot-making at rank correlation 0.70 only; wide uncertainty (sd) for low-volume players.

findings.question: Do teammates shoot threes better when he is on the floor?
findings.unit: teammate 3P% lift, percentage points (career, shrunk)
findings.pool: all career rows with an estimate (1195)
findings.caveat: Real but small: true spread across players is about 0.5 pp per teammate three; most intervals include zero.

findings.question: Do opponents stop attacking the rim when he is on the floor?
findings.unit: opponent rim attempts avoided, league SD units (lineup-adjusted; higher = more deterrence)
findings.caveat: Deterrence improves held-out lineup forecasts as a SiPM input; one season is noisy for low-minute players.

findings.question: Do award voters see his defense the way the numbers do?
findings.unit: All-Defensive vote share
findings.pool: players with 1,000+ defensive possessions in 2025-26 (387); measured = prior-informed defensive RAPM (xd), box = DBPM
findings.caveat: Voters lean on box-score defense (DBPM) from last season; they do not lag measured defense (E38a null). Votes cover only the best defenders.

findings.question: How much of Brandon Miller's usage does he take when Brandon Miller sits?
findings.unit: change in his share of team plays, percentage points (star out minus star in); pred = model expectation; frac = share of the star's usage
findings.caveat: Few games per absence (median 5); why the star sat is unknown. UA01 (proportional sharing) not supported.
